model.title: A resolution designating October 8, 2026, as "National Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Day".

summary.text: The resolution would designate October 8, 2026, as "National Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Day" to recognize and raise awareness about hydrogen and fuel cell technologies and their potential role in addressing energy and environmental challenges.
